scenarios.title: Integration enablement and limits
scenarios.setup: Integration services disabled at initial setup.
scenarios.expect: Admin enables services and configures bounded limits; non-admin changes fail; disabled protocols fail closed.

scenarios.title: Scoped credentials and revocation
scenarios.setup: Create separate OPDS and per-device KOReader credentials.
scenarios.expect: One-time UI password display; only own metadata listed; revoke is idempotent; revoked credentials fail on every path.

scenarios.title: Credential authority boundaries
scenarios.setup: Try main password, OPDS secret as bearer, KOReader key as OPDS and vice versa.
scenarios.expect: Only designated transport and scope accepted; HTTPS required outside explicit dev mode; no secrets in URLs/logs.

scenarios.title: Account disablement
scenarios.setup: Disable credential owner before reads and queued delivery execution.
scenarios.expect: All paths reject disabled account; no new SMTP submission or private state disclosure.

scenarios.title: Atom root and acquisition feeds
scenarios.setup: Synthetic titles with XML metacharacters, non-ASCII text and multiple formats.
scenarios.expect: Namespace-aware parser validates required Atom/OPDS fields, correct media types, self/start/search/acquisition links and safe escaping.

scenarios.title: JSON root and acquisition feeds
scenarios.setup: Use the same catalog as Atom.
scenarios.expect: Pinned upstream schema and semantic checks pass; metadata and original acquisition identities agree across versions.

scenarios.title: Catalog and artwork authorization
scenarios.setup: Two libraries; caller granted one; shared title spans both.
scenarios.expect: Lists/totals/detail/cover never expose inaccessible names/IDs/paths; unknown or ungranted lookup has no metadata body.

scenarios.title: Search and deterministic pages
scenarios.setup: More than 50 synthetic publications with duplicate labels and search punctuation.
scenarios.expect: Literal normalized search; deterministic UUID tiebreak; page=0/size=50 default, cap=200; filtered counts and next links correct.

scenarios.title: Exact original acquisition
scenarios.setup: Acquire ebook/comic/audio originals with Range/HEAD/If-Match.
scenarios.expect: Bytes/hash/MIME/length match; 206/416/ETag/412 correct; no cookies or token query required; revoked grant denied.

scenarios.title: Individual audio file publications
scenarios.setup: A three-file recording with explicit file sequence.
scenarios.expect: Each publication downloads that original file; recording/order context is accurate; no whole-recording package or streaming guarantee invented.

scenarios.title: Replacement and missing content
scenarios.setup: Replace bytes after feed read, then make share unavailable.
scenarios.expect: Old version fails 412; missing/unavailable bytes are explicit; no new credentials or silent replacement acquisition.

scenarios.title: Pinned external OPDS client
scenarios.setup: Configure a real pinned OPDS client/emulator with synthetic app credential.
scenarios.expect: Browse, search and download work with Basic auth on all linked resources; record client version and hardware limits.

scenarios.title: Server and personal SMTP settings
scenarios.setup: Two accounts and separate local sink transports.
scenarios.expect: Only admin edits server; each user owns personal; choices explicit; no silent fallback or server secret disclosure.

scenarios.title: Encrypted secrets and unavailable keys
scenarios.setup: Save a synthetic password, inspect persisted record, remove/wrong-key restart.
scenarios.expect: No plaintext password or suffix in read/log; authenticated encryption; unavailable key blocks sends without destroying settings.

scenarios.title: TLS and connection tests
scenarios.setup: Local SMTP fixtures for TLS success, untrusted certificate and required STARTTLS absence.
scenarios.expect: Connection tests send no mail; validate certificates; never downgrade TLS; plaintext only explicit local test mode.

scenarios.title: Private saved recipients
scenarios.setup: Two accounts, concurrent recipient edits and delete replay.
scenarios.expect: Owner-only CRUD; server revisions/receipts; tombstones; stale revision 409; CRLF/header injection refused.

scenarios.title: Explicit immutable send
scenarios.setup: User picks exact original file/version, saved recipient and transport revision.
scenarios.expect: 202 persisted delivery+receipt+job atomically; file/recipient/transport snapshots explicit; history only visible to owner.

scenarios.title: Original attachments and MIME
scenarios.setup: Send one EPUB, comic and original audio to local sink.
scenarios.expect: One attachment per message, exact byte hash, safe filename/MIME/headers and no conversion.

scenarios.title: Repeated delivery requests
scenarios.setup: Repeat same operation concurrently and after response loss.
scenarios.expect: One delivery/job; identical replay returns original status/body; changed payload with same operation is 409.

scenarios.title: Execution-time authorization and versions
scenarios.setup: Revoke grant/disable account/change file, recipient or selected SMTP revision while queued.
scenarios.expect: No SMTP submission to stale or changed destination; terminal typed failure; no fallback.

scenarios.title: Known pre-acceptance retries
scenarios.setup: Sink gives temporary connection/recipient rejection before DATA submission.
scenarios.expect: Bounded retry ledger; delays/attempt limits obey contract; no tight loop or extra accepted message.

scenarios.title: Permanent SMTP refusal
scenarios.setup: Sink refuses recipient permanently.
scenarios.expect: Failed state with sanitized reason; no automatic retry; no inbox-delivery claim.

scenarios.title: Lost SMTP acknowledgement
scenarios.setup: Sink accepts message but final acknowledgement is lost.
scenarios.expect: outcome_unknown; one submission; restart/redelivery never automatically sends a second message.

scenarios.title: Worker crash at send boundary
scenarios.setup: Crash after durable submission marker, before or after final SMTP response.
scenarios.expect: Ambiguous sending attempt recovers as outcome_unknown; known accepted persisted result stays accepted; no duplicate send.

scenarios.title: Cancellation and explicit resend
scenarios.setup: Cancel queued request and request resend of uncertain outcome.
scenarios.expect: Cancel only before submission; resend requires new operation and duplicate acknowledgement; old result stays unchanged.

scenarios.title: Attachment and per-user rate bounds
scenarios.setup: Large attachment, invalid input and concurrent per-user rate requests.
scenarios.expect: Default 25 MiB raw attachment ceiling, configurable up to 100 MiB, 10 requests/user/hour default; reject before network/large allocation.

scenarios.title: Stock protocol envelopes
scenarios.setup: Exercise pinned client auth and disabled registration with synthetic credentials.
scenarios.expect: Correct header names/envelopes/statuses; no account creation/deletion or body/secret logging.

scenarios.title: Binary partial digest vectors
scenarios.setup: Small, boundary and sparse large synthetic files plus filename mode mismatch.
scenarios.expect: Independent upstream/client hash agreement; filename mode unsupported; hash is lookup hint, not identity.

scenarios.title: Digest ambiguity and explicit binding
scenarios.setup: Identical and deliberately colliding partial digests span two editions/libraries.
scenarios.expect: No first-match choice; owner binds exact granted file/version; denied/unknown binding refuses without disclosing candidates.

scenarios.title: Separate progress source
scenarios.setup: Read a cataloged file in web and KOReader.
scenarios.expect: KOReader raw progress remains separate; web/Android canonical location, completion and title history remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: Intentional backward progress
scenarios.setup: Device A reads baseline then moves backward without a competing device.
scenarios.expect: Server revision advances; smaller percentage accepted; clocks/percentage never decide arbitration.

scenarios.title: Concurrent device candidates
scenarios.setup: A and B read; A writes; B uploads a different position.
scenarios.expect: B is retained as private candidate; canonical unchanged; 409 is explicit; B GET does not silently rebase a stale upload.

scenarios.title: Protocol response loss and replay
scenarios.setup: Repeat identical payload after lost success/conflict response and restart.
scenarios.expect: Replay saved success/timestamp only while that result remains canonical; otherwise retain one deduplicated candidate. Repeated refusals return the same failure/candidate; no duplicate canonical updates, conflicts or resurrection.

scenarios.title: Owner conflict resolution and retry
scenarios.setup: Resolve candidate with keep_server/use_candidate, retry and race another resolve.
scenarios.expect: Owner+grant/current revision required; stale resolution retained; old automatic wire replay cannot undo decision; web/Android untouched. A deliberate reapply of an already resolved valid candidate is a new revisioned owner operation; its old candidate/receipt remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: Moves, replacements and revoked grants
scenarios.setup: Move file, replace bytes with matching partial digest, revoke grant.
scenarios.expect: Move preserves identity; replacement binding invalidated; version mismatch retained/refused; inaccessible state never returned.

scenarios.title: Pinned unmodified KOReader
scenarios.setup: Use two installations or faithful pinned client request recordings plus at least one real client/emulator.
scenarios.expect: Auth, read/backward/write, conflict failure and settings recovery observed; no assertion of echoed native revisions.

scenarios.title: Settings, send and conflict UI
scenarios.setup: Real web/API/PostgreSQL and local SMTP; two browser accounts.
scenarios.expect: Settings accessible; secrets shown only at creation; explicit send states/uncertain warning; conflict actions and account-switch cleanup verified.

scenarios.title: Existing behavior and release hold
scenarios.setup: Run T003/T005 contract/server regressions and reader isolation locally.
scenarios.expect: No changed existing success schemas; no Android/archive/.github changes, CI activation, tags, releases, deployments, real recipients or secret access.
